name: bose-headphones-control
description: A local desktop control panel for compatible Bose headphones.

scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:electron && npm run test:native && npm run test:swift-backend && npm run test:ios
scripts.test:native: swiftc native-macos/BackendProcessController.swift tests/test_native_backend_process.swift -o /tmp/bose-native-process-tests && /tmp/bose-native-process-tests && swiftc -parse-as-library -typecheck native-macos/BoseHeadphonesControl.swift native-macos/NativeBackend.swift native-macos/BackendProcessController.swift -framework SwiftUI -framework AppKit
scripts.test:swift-backend: swiftc native-swift-macos/BoseBMAP.swift tests/test_swift_bmap.swift -o /tmp/bose-swift-bmap-tests && /tmp/bose-swift-bmap-tests && swiftc -parse-as-library -typecheck native-macos/BoseHeadphonesControl.swift native-swift-macos/BoseBMAP.swift native-swift-macos/BoseRFCOMMClient.swift native-swift-macos/NativeBackend.swift -framework SwiftUI -framework AppKit -framework IOBluetooth
scripts.make:mac: npm run build:backend && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
scripts.make:linux: npm run prepare:linux-backend && electron-builder --linux AppImage pacman --arm64

extendInfo.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Bose Headphones Control uses Bluetooth to communicate with your paired Bose headphones.
